Apgar Score — FHIR Questionnaire Template

The five Apgar criteria at 1 and 5 minutes after birth, each with its total (0–10) and result band.

Scoring

Each criterion scores 0–2. The total (0–10) at each time point is reassuring at 7–10, moderately abnormal at 4–6 and low at 0–3.

Questions

  1. Color (appearance)
    • The baby's whole body is completely bluish-gray or pale
    • Good color in body with bluish hands or feet
    • Good color all over
  2. Heart rate (pulse)
    • No heart rate
    • Fewer than 100 beats per minute
    • At least 100 beats per minute
  3. Muscle tone (activity)
    • Limp; no movement
    • Some flexion of arms and legs
    • Active motion
  4. Reflex irritability (grimace)
    • No response to airways being suctioned
    • Grimace during suctioning
    • Grimace and pulling away, cough, or sneeze during suctioning
  5. Respiratory effort
    • Not breathing
    • Weak cry; may sound like whimpering, slow or irregular breathing
    • Good, strong cry; normal rate and effort of breathing
  6. Color (appearance)
    • The baby's whole body is completely bluish-gray or pale
    • Good color in body with bluish hands or feet
    • Good color all over
  7. Heart rate (pulse)
    • No heart rate
    • Fewer than 100 beats per minute
    • At least 100 beats per minute
  8. Muscle tone (activity)
    • Limp; no movement
    • Some flexion of arms and legs
    • Active motion
  9. Reflex irritability (grimace)
    • No response to airways being suctioned
    • Grimace during suctioning
    • Grimace and pulling away, cough, or sneeze during suctioning
  10. Respiratory effort
    • Not breathing
    • Weak cry; may sound like whimpering, slow or irregular breathing
    • Good, strong cry; normal rate and effort of breathing

Use it

  1. Download the FHIR Questionnaire JSON, or
  2. open the Builder, choose + Add → From template…, search for “Apgar Score” and insert it. It arrives as one titled group with its calculations wired, and you can keep editing it.
